name: whopsdk-mock
description: Stateful in-process mock for the Whop TypeScript SDK

scripts.test: npm run build && tsx tests/payout-test.ts && tsx tests/dispute-test.ts && tsx tests/payments-test.ts
scripts.test:http: npm run build && node --test tests/http-server.test.mjs tests/dispute-platform.test.mjs tests/partner-contract.test.mjs tests/expanded-http.test.mjs tests/session-isolation.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:baseline && npm run test:compat && npm run test:http && npm run test:partners
scripts.test:partners: npm run build && node tests/partner/partner-runner.mjs tests/partner/evidence-worker.mjs && node tests/partner/reliability-client.mjs && node tests/partner/scenario-author.mjs
scripts.test:compat: npm run build && node --test tests/current-api.test.mjs tests/current-surface.test.mjs tests/api-behavior.test.mjs tests/schema-validation.test.mjs tests/parity-check.test.mjs examples/dispute-workflow.test.mjs && node scripts/audit-sdk.mjs
